facts.text: Honeybee foragers can move pollen among flowering plants while searching for nectar and pollen.
facts.ev: Honeybee foragers move pollen among flowering plants as they search for food.

facts.text: Heat, dirt, and shade can reduce how efficiently a photovoltaic panel converts sunlight into electricity.
facts.ev: Heat, dirt, and shade can lower photovoltaic conversion efficiency.

facts.text: Groundwater seeps into streambeds and helps keep water flowing in streams between rainstorms.
facts.ev: Groundwater seeps into streambeds and helps keep water flowing in streams.

facts.text: An arch sends horizontal thrust toward its supports, so its foundations must resist those lateral forces.
facts.ev: Arch supports and foundations must resist horizontal thrust.

facts.text: Public libraries provide internet-connected computers that patrons can use for information and services.
facts.ev: Library patrons can use public computers to access the internet.

facts.text: The Sun always illuminates half of the Moon, but the visible portion of that half changes as the Moon orbits Earth.
facts.ev: We see different portions of the Moon's sunlit half as it orbits Earth.
facts.tag: changing view of the illuminated Moon

facts.text: Many cacti have shallow roots spread near the surface, where they can quickly take up water from a light shower.
facts.ev: Shallow cactus roots can capture water from light showers.

facts.text: For an ideal lever, mechanical advantage depends on the effort arm's length divided by the resistance arm's length.
facts.ev: An ideal lever's mechanical advantage is the effort-arm length divided by the resistance-arm length.

facts.text: When pedaling becomes difficult, shifting to a lower gear can make the effort easier, especially on a climb.
facts.ev: A lower gear makes pedaling easier when the effort increases.
facts.tag: using a lower gear on a climb

facts.text: Rust forms when iron reacts with oxygen in the presence of water, and the corrosion can continue through the porous rust layer.
facts.ev: Iron can rust through a reaction involving oxygen and water.

facts.text: Dust that settles on a solar-powered Mars rover's panels can reduce the electrical power it generates from sunlight.
facts.ev: Dust on rover solar panels reduces the power they can generate.

facts.text: Movable type let printers reuse individual letters to assemble different pages instead of copying every book by hand.
facts.ev: Movable type could be rearranged to print different pages.

facts.text: Many marine organisms depend on coral reefs for habitat, shelter, and food.
facts.ev: Many marine organisms depend on coral reefs for habitat and shelter.

facts.text: A lightning flash heats nearby air rapidly, and the air's sudden expansion creates the shock wave heard as thunder.
facts.ev: Rapidly heated air expands and creates thunder's shock wave.

facts.text: A bit is a binary digit that encodes information as either a zero or a one.
facts.ev: A bit is a binary digit representing either zero or one.
